card.title: HERMOSA
card.text: Hermosa is a town in the northern part of the Bataan Peninsula.

Text.SourceString: Hermosa is a town in the northern part of the Bataan Peninsula.
Text.LocalizedString: Hermosa is a town in the northern part of the Bataan Peninsula.

value.value: Our enemy, suffering from severe lack of supplies and under constant bombardment, is wilting. It is now ripe for the taking, do not fail us.

value.value: We have a strong air force at our beck and call. Put it to good use.

value.value: Some of our scout units are in prime position to wreak havoc on the enemy.
